bullets: On Monday 2 November, DLD recorded 822 sales worth AED 2.1bn, up 10.2% on a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 58.9% of the total on Monday, compared to 56.3% over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,721 per sqft, up 3.3% from the 30-day average and down 3.7% from last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 239 sales, Liwan1 with 185 sales, and Dubai South with 150 sales.
In October new rental contracts for 1BR apartments in JVC had a median of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Clients who graduated from a university abroad could qualify for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa, so check the details before advising.
Dubai South housing is seeing a boom with studios dominating and rents more than doubling as home sales beat the 2025 record in just 8 months.
Brent oil recently slid to $93 and $94 due to Iran uncertainty after US midterms, which can move investor sentiment.
